retrieved.text: Students normally have 15 days from announcement of results to submit the prescribed re-evaluation form to the Controller of Examinations and pay the applicable fee. The manual lists a non-refundable charge of ₹5,000 for each subject, subject to changes in university policy. Incomplete forms can be rejected.

Re-evaluation results appear in the ERP. Students cannot view the answer sheet after it has been re-evaluated. When revised marks call for a new grade sheet, the student must hand in the previous grade sheet.

End-of-semester and make-up theory papers can be submitted for re-evaluation. This service excludes supplementary exams and summer-term courses. Midterms, practicals, labs, assignments, projects, internships and viva assessments also fall outside the re-evaluation scope.

Programme-wise results for December 2024 end-term exams started appearing on 10 January 2025 and were released in phases. Students were asked to check ERP for updates. Odd semester make-up results were announced on 31 January 2025, and odd semester supplementary results on 4 March 2025.
The exam manual schedules issuance of both grade sheets and transcripts after 15 days from publication of the result.
